## The Python files, in reading order

*At import time* means as the module is imported: at module level, in a class body, or in a module-level `if` or `try`; and not inside a function or a method, nor under `if TYPE_CHECKING:` or `if __name__ == "__main__":`. The table is a dependency order: a file comes after every file of this chapter that it imports at import time. It is made by taking the files in path order and listing, before each, whatever it imports that is not yet listed. So a file is read just after what it needs, and the files of one directory are not always together. Imports from other chapters, and imports that do not run at import time, do not order anything.

No files of this chapter import each other in a cycle at import time.

*imports* is how many files of this chapter the file imports, written a+b: a at import time, b only otherwise (those are named in the next table; all of them are in `files.json`). *defines* lists the classes defined at module level and, after the dot, the functions; a name bound by assignment or by import is not listed, so a file of settings or of re-exports shows nothing. *~tokens so far* is the running total.
